name: sapphireit/sapphireit-editorial-workflow
description: Editorial approval workflow for WordPress posts, pages and custom post types.

scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: phpcbf: fix what phpcs can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.test: PHP unit tests (no WordPress, no database).
scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Download a WordPress core checkout and create the test database (no Docker).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: PHP integration tests against the WordPress test library. Drops all tables in the test database.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Coverage of both suites plus WorkflowManager branch coverage, checked against the release minimums. Needs Xdebug (branch coverage); reports in coverage/.
